citation.authors: Wafa HA, Wolfe CDA, Rudd A, Wang Y

cited_by.title: Stroke: signs to act on and what raises the risk

record.population: 3,088 first ischaemic stroke patients in the South London Stroke Register, 2000 to 2015
record.design: Prospective population-based study, trends in incidence
record.finding: Age-adjusted ischaemic stroke incidence fell 43% (137.3 to 78.4 per 100,000 per year) across the period, in both White and Black groups, though the fall in the Black group was not significant (144.6 to 116.2; P=0.31). Statin use before stroke rose four-fold while preventive blood pressure and antiplatelet use fell, despite more hypertension.
record.note: Smaller Black subgroups limited the power to detect trends; the abstract states this.
